title: Workflow rules: one rule cannot hold several conditions, each with its own actions

panels.caption: Workflow rule editor (Leads): one CONDITION and one set of actions, no way to add another condition
Workflow rule (Deals, Big Deal Rule): Condition 1 with its own actions, + Add another condition

rows.zoho: Up to 10, checked in order (first match wins; "records not meeting any of the above" from the 2nd on)
Each condition has its own instant and scheduled actions
rows.tavi: One action list for the whole rule

rows.b: Same criteria in two conditions of one rule
rows.zoho: Refused (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING: the criteria is part of another condition)

notes: TAVI stores a rule as one criteria + one actions list (GET /workflow/rules/{id}: keys trigger, criteria, mode, actions; read 22 Oct 2026).
Workaround today: several separate rules, but they all fire when their criteria match, so there is no first-match-wins or "else".
Zoho sources: Update Workflow Rule API (up to 10 conditions, unique criteria per condition, no duplicate action inside a condition) and Troubleshooting Workflows (conditions run like a nested if).
